title: Binary Domain
shortDescription: Toshihiro Nagoshi's cyberpunk squad shooter set in 2080 Tokyo featuring procedural robot armor degradation.
historicalSignificance: Praised for its responsive squad trust system, voice recognition commanding, and satisfying piece-by-piece robot dismemberment.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
